nc3b0818b81.headline: Libya: American Giant Guidry Wants to Build a $1.5 Billion Port
nc3b0818b81.summary: The Guidry Group is set to sign a contract with Libyan authorities to construct a $1.5 billion port in the city of Susah.
nc3b0818b81.why: This major infrastructure project represents significant foreign investment in Libya, potentially boosting trade capacity and economic development in the region.
